      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

												 '</div>';

					var lb = new lightbox.Lightbox(
						{
							lightboxId: 'ftueLightbox',
							contents: contents,
							closeOnBodyClick: false,

						} );

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

												 'value="' + buttonText + '" onclick=\'window.location="' + redirectUrl + '"\' />' +
												 '</div>';

					var lb = new lightbox.Lightbox(
						{
							lightboxId: 'ftueLightbox',
							contents: contents,
							closeOnBodyClick: false,
							onClose: 'showTooltip()'
						} );

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

				}

					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );

					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}

      }

					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );

					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );

      }

												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

			function openFtue(title, bodyText, buttonText, redirectUrl) {
				if ( redirectUrl ) {
					var contents = '<div id="ftueLightboxWrapper">' +
												 '<span class="ftueTitle" >' + title + '</span>' +
												 '<img class="ftueImage" src="/images/ci/ftue/AssistPromoModal.png"/>' +
												 '<span class="ftueText" >' + bodyText + '</span>' +
												 '</div>' +
												 '<div id="ftueFooter">' +
												 '<input class="submit ftueButton" type="submit" role="button" ' +
												 'value="' + buttonText + '" onclick=\'window.location="' + redirectUrl + '"\' />' +
												 '</div>';

					var lb = new lightbox.Lightbox(
						{
							lightboxId: 'ftueLightbox',
							contents: contents,
							closeOnBodyClick: false,
							onClose: 'showTooltip()'
						} );
					lb.open();
				}
			}

			
			if ( false )

				var redirect = "/webapps/bb-social-learning-BBLEARN/execute/mybb?cmd=display&toolId=LTI_LAUNCH_PLUGIN_____";

					'Explore\x20Assist', redirect)

  <script type="application/javascript">

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

			function openFtue(title, bodyText, buttonText, redirectUrl) {
				if ( redirectUrl ) {
					var contents = '<div id="ftueLightboxWrapper">' +
												 '<span class="ftueTitle" >' + title + '</span>' +
												 '<img class="ftueImage" src="/images/ci/ftue/AssistPromoModal.png"/>' +
												 '<span class="ftueText" >' + bodyText + '</span>' +
												 '</div>' +
												 '<div id="ftueFooter">' +
												 '<input class="submit ftueButton" type="submit" role="button" ' +
												 'value="' + buttonText + '" onclick=\'window.location="' + redirectUrl + '"\' />' +
												 '</div>';

					var lb = new lightbox.Lightbox(
						{
							lightboxId: 'ftueLightbox',
							contents: contents,
							closeOnBodyClick: false,
							onClose: 'showTooltip()'
						} );
					lb.open();
				}
			}

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

			function openFtue(title, bodyText, buttonText, redirectUrl) {
				if ( redirectUrl ) {
					var contents = '<div id="ftueLightboxWrapper">' +
												 '<span class="ftueTitle" >' + title + '</span>' +
												 '<img class="ftueImage" src="/images/ci/ftue/AssistPromoModal.png"/>' +
												 '<span class="ftueText" >' + bodyText + '</span>' +
												 '</div>' +
												 '<div id="ftueFooter">' +
												 '<input class="submit ftueButton" type="submit" role="button" ' +
												 'value="' + buttonText + '" onclick=\'window.location="' + redirectUrl + '"\' />' +
												 '</div>';

					var lb = new lightbox.Lightbox(
						{
							lightboxId: 'ftueLightbox',
							contents: contents,
							closeOnBodyClick: false,
							onClose: 'showTooltip()'
						} );
					lb.open();
				}
			}

			
			if ( false )
			{
				var redirect = "/webapps/bb-social-learning-BBLEARN/execute/mybb?cmd=display&toolId=LTI_LAUNCH_PLUGIN_____";

    {
      if( top === self )

 <div md-src-pos="28..214"> 
  <span md-src-pos="28..77">To ensure academic honesty and maximize learning,</span>&nbsp;

 </div> 
 <h2 id="anonymous_element_27" md-src-pos="216..251">Originality and Prohibited Reuse</h2> 
 <ul style="list-style-type: disc;" md-src-pos="252..592"> 
  <li style="list-style-type: inherit;" md-src-pos="252..380"><strong md-src-pos="254..278">No Project "Cloning"</strong>: You cannot adopt an entire existing open-source project and present it as your team's original work.</li> 
  <li style="list-style-type: inherit;" md-src-pos="381..592"><strong md-src-pos="383..412">No Cross-Course Recycling</strong>: You are prohibited from reusing or adapting projects previously submitted to other courses (e.g., OOAD, Innovation Practices), external competitions, or prior semesters of CS304.</li> 
 </ul> 
 <h2 id="anonymous_element_28" md-src-pos="594..627">Third-Party Libraries and APIs</h2> 
 <ul style="list-style-type: disc;" md-src-pos="628..967"> 
  <li style="list-style-type: inherit;" md-src-pos="628..830"><strong md-src-pos="630..661">Implementation Requirements</strong>: While you are encouraged to use third-party libraries, frameworks, and APIs, the core functionalities of your project must be designed and implemented by your team.</li> 
  <li style="list-style-type: inherit;" md-src-pos="831..967"><strong md-src-pos="833..858">Mandatory Attribution</strong>: All third-party tools, libraries, or external resources must be clearly documented and properly referenced.</li> 
 </ul> 
 <h2 id="anonymous_element_29" md-src-pos="969..986">AI Integration</h2> 
 <div md-src-pos="987..1192"> 
  <span md-src-pos="990..1059">AI is a fundamental part of the modern software engineering workflow.</span>&nbsp; 
  <span md-src-pos="1064..1139">We encourage you to leverage AI tools throughout the development lifecycle,</span>&nbsp; 
  <span md-src-pos="1140..1191">provided you follow these transparency requirements</span>: 
 </div> 
 <ul style="list-style-type: disc;" md-src-pos="1193..1426"> 
  <li style="list-style-type: inherit;" md-src-pos="1193..1426">Any code, documentation, or technical artifacts generated or assisted by AI must include clear, concise references. Specific instructions for referencing AI usage will be provided within the requirements for each project milestone.</li> 
 </ul> 
 <div md-src-pos="1428..1587"> 
  <span md-src-pos="1428..1503">Any violation of these policies constitutes a breach of academic integrity.</span>&nbsp; 
  <span md-src-pos="1504..1587">Misconduct will result in serious penalties as defined by the CS department policy (attached).</span>

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

												 '<img class="ftueImage" src="/images/ci/ftue/AssistPromoModal.png"/>' +

												 '</div>' +
												 '<div id="ftueFooter">' +
												 '<input class="submit ftueButton" type="submit" role="button" ' +
												 'value="' + buttonText + '" onclick=\'window.location="' + redirectUrl + '"\' />' +
												 '</div>';

					var lb = new lightbox.Lightbox(
						{
							lightboxId: 'ftueLightbox',
							contents: contents,
							closeOnBodyClick: false,
							onClose: 'showTooltip()'
						} );
					lb.open();
				}
			}

  Review Submission History: Open Source PR  </span></h1>

    <h2 class="hideoff">Content</h2>
    <script type="text/javascript" src="/webapps/achievements/js/achievement.js"></script><link rel="stylesheet" href="/webapps/achievements/css/achievements.css" type="text/css" media="screen" /><script type="text/javascript">

       <h2> <a role="button" class="" href="#" onclick="inlineGrading.gradingUtil.toggleOnEvent( event, $('contentDetails'), false, 'a' );" 
            title="Assignment Instructions Click to view/hide content"

          <span>Assignment Instructions</span>

     <!--  Tab Panel -->
    <div class="collapseTabs" id="contentDetails" style=" display:none;  ">
    
    <!-- Tabs -->
               <!--  Content  -->
         <div class="collapseTabsData" id="contentAreaBlock0">
                         <div id="instructionId" style="height:auto; overflow:visible;">
               <div class="vtbegenerated"> 
 <h1 md-src-pos="0..66">Individual Assignment: Open Source PR Contribution (6 Points)</h1> 
 <p md-src-pos="68..324"><span md-src-pos="68..87">In this assignment,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="88..179">your task is to contribute to an open-source software project by submitting a pull request.</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="180..254">This assignment will help you engage with real-world software development,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="255..292">understand open-source collaboration,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="293..324">and improve your coding skills.</span></p> 
 <h2 md-src-pos="326..341">Requirements</h2> 
 <h3 md-src-pos="343..383">1. Selecting an Open-Source Project:</h3> 
 <p md-src-pos="384..468"><span md-src-pos="384..467">The project must be a substantial software application with a non-trivial codebase.</span></p> 
 <ul md-src-pos="469..1000"> 
  <li md-src-pos="469..621">As a rough guideline, the project should contain at least 20 source files or multiple modules/components, and typically involve multiple contributors.</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="622..815">It must not be a tutorial, course material, assignments, documentation repository, wiki, demo, small prototype, or a simple collection of scripts (e.g., small crawlers or automation scripts).</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="816..865">It must be compilable, runnable, and testable.</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="866..910">It must have at least 50 stars on GitHub.</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="911..1000">It must have been created at least one year ago and remain active within the past year.</li> 
 </ul> 
 <p md-src-pos="1002..1035"><span md-src-pos="1002..1034">Projects that CANNOT be selected</span>:</p> 
 <ul md-src-pos="1036..1302"> 
  <li md-src-pos="1036..1078"><a md-src-pos="1038..1078" href="https://github.com/sismics/docs">Teedy</a></li> 
  <li md-src-pos="1079..1249">Projects related to your team project. For example, if your team project adds a new feature to an existing open-source project, you CANNOT reuse it for this assignment.</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="1250..1302">Team projects of this course from past semesters.</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="1250..1302">Projects created by yourself.</li> 
 </ul> 
 <p md-src-pos="1304..1421"><span md-src-pos="1304..1359">If you are unsure whether a project meets the criteria,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1360..1421">please ask your lab tutor for confirmation before proceeding.</span></p> 
 <h3 md-src-pos="1423..1459">2. Pull Request (PR) Submission:</h3> 
 <p md-src-pos="1460..1831"><span md-src-pos="1460..1523">Your pull request must introduce a meaningful functional change</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1525..1541">to the software,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1542..1588">such as implementing a new feature or fixing a</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1590..1605">non-trivial bug</span>&nbsp;(<span md-src-pos="1607..1612">e.g.,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1613..1657">a logic error that causes incorrect behavior</span>)<span md-src-pos="1658..1659">.</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1661..1724">The change must modify the application logic and affect how the</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1726..1757">software behaves when executed.</span></p> 
 <p md-src-pos="1833..2103"><span md-src-pos="1833..1849">For inspiration,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1850..1907">you may explore the open issues of the selected projects.</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1908..1918">Typically,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1919..1980">open issues include unresolved bugs and new feature requests.</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1981..1984">Or,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="1985..2031">you may use the selected project as end users,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="2032..2103">and see if you can identify potential problems or feature improvements.</span></p> 
 <p md-src-pos="2105..2247"><span md-src-pos="2105..2168">If your PR is associated with an existing issue in the project,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="2169..2186">the issue must be</span>&nbsp;<strong md-src-pos="2187..2195">open</strong>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="2196..2247">at the time of submission and not already resolved.</span></p> 
 <p md-src-pos="2250..2321"><span md-src-pos="2250..2283">The following types of changes do</span>&nbsp;<strong md-src-pos="2284..2291">NOT</strong>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="2292..2320">count as valid contributions</span>:</p> 
 <ul md-src-pos="2323..2843"> 
  <li md-src-pos="2323..2373">Documentation updates (e.g., README, wiki pages)</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="2374..2429">Formatting or style changes (e.g., code reformatting)</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="2430..2471">Renaming variables, functions, or files</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="2472..2509">Dependency or configuration updates</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="2510..2556">Grammar, translation or localization changes</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="2557..2631">Minor parameter or constant adjustments that do not modify program logic</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="2632..2714">Changes limited to test code (e.g., adding or modifying unit tests or test data)</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="2715..2843">Adding code that is not integrated into the application's execution (e.g., unused classes, functions, or standalone utilities)</li> 
 </ul> 
 <p md-src-pos="2847..3042"><span md-src-pos="2847..2943">The above list is not exhaustive and may be updated during the course if additional cases arise.</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="2944..3042">The instructor reserves the right to determine whether a contribution is sufficiently substantial.</span></p> 
 <p md-src-pos="3044..3308"><span md-src-pos="3044..3076">You may check our course website</span>&nbsp;(<a md-src-pos="3078..3110" href="https://sustech-cs304.github.io/">https://sustech-cs304.github.io/</a>)&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3112..3115">for</span>&nbsp;"<a md-src-pos="3117..3182" href="https://sustech-cs304.github.io/docs/merged-prs/25S">Merged PRs</a>"&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3184..3220">from past semesters for inspiration.</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3221..3229">However,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3230..3264">as assignment requirements evolve,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3265..3308">not all past PRs meet the current criteria.</span></p> 
 <p md-src-pos="3310..3452"><span md-src-pos="3310..3316">Again,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3317..3383">if you are unsure whether your proposed change meets the criteria,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3384..3452">please ask your lab tutor for confirmation before submitting the PR.</span></p> 
 <h2 md-src-pos="3187..3200">Evaluation</h2> 
 <ol md-src-pos="3202..3424"> 
  <li md-src-pos="3202..3268"> <p md-src-pos="3205..3268">Submit a PR to an open source project that meets the criteria.</p> </li> 
  <li md-src-pos="3270..3328"> <p md-src-pos="3273..3328">The PR introduces a non-trivial functional code change.</p> </li> 
  <li md-src-pos="3330..3424"> <p md-src-pos="3333..3424">(Bonus) The PR gets accepted and merged into the upstream repository before June 7th, 2026.</p> </li> 
 </ol> 
 <p md-src-pos="3693..3876"><span md-src-pos="3693..3717">We will evaluate your PR</span>&nbsp;<strong md-src-pos="3718..3772">onsite during lab sessions from week 6 to week 13</strong><span md-src-pos="3772..3773">.</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3775..3793">Ask your lab tutor</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3803..3827">to check the PR when you</span>'<span md-src-pos="3828..3837">re ready.</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="3838..3876">You should demo the PR and explain it.</span></p> 
 <p md-src-pos="3878..3887"><strong md-src-pos="3878..3886">Note</strong>:</p> 
 <ul md-src-pos="3888..4100"> 
  <li md-src-pos="3888..4018">The PR should be newly created for this assignment, not previously submitted or created for other purposes before this semester.</li> 
  <li md-src-pos="4019..4100">No score will be given to this assignment if you didn't ask us to check onsite.</li> 
 </ul> 
 <h2 md-src-pos="4103..4114">AI Usage</h2> 
 <p md-src-pos="4115..4232"><span md-src-pos="4115..4157">You may use AI tools to support your work,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="4158..4232">but you must understand and take responsibility for everything you submit.</span></p> 
 <p md-src-pos="4234..4508"><span md-src-pos="4234..4278">Do not use AI to generate or submit trivial,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="4279..4291">low-quality,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="4292..4320">or irrelevant pull requests,</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="4321..4372">or to flood projects with artificial contributions.</span>&nbsp;<span md-src-pos="4373..4508">Such behavior is considered irresponsible and may negatively impact upstream project maintainers and the broader open-source community.</span></p>

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

												 '</div>' +
												 '<div id="ftueFooter">' +
												 '<input class="submit ftueButton" type="submit" role="button" ' +
												 'value="' + buttonText + '" onclick=\'window.location="' + redirectUrl + '"\' />' +
												 '</div>';

					var lb = new lightbox.Lightbox(
						{
							lightboxId: 'ftueLightbox',
							contents: contents,
							closeOnBodyClick: false,
							onClose: 'showTooltip()'
						} );
					lb.open();
				}

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

												 '</div>';

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

      function showTooltip() {
				var tooltipBtn = '<input class="submit tooltipButton" type="submit" role="button"' +
												 'value="Got\x20it" id="tooltipButton" onclick="removeTooltip()" } />';
				if ( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) ) {
					if ( $j( "#tooltipButton" ) ) $j( "#tooltipButton" ).remove();
					$j( "#ftueTooltip" ).append( tooltipBtn );
				}

      	if ( $j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).css('visibility') === 'visible' ) {
					$j( ".global-nav-bar-wrap-mobile-nav" ).prepend( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				} else {
					$j( "#global-nav" ).append( $j( "#ftueTooltip" ) );
				}
        $j( "#ftueTooltip" ).css('visibility', 'visible');
      }

			function removeTooltip() {
				if ( $j( '#ftueTooltip' ) ) {
					$j( '#ftueTooltip' ).remove();
				}
			}

			function openFtue(title, bodyText, buttonText, redirectUrl) {
				if ( redirectUrl ) {
					var contents = '<div id="ftueLightboxWrapper">' +
												 '<span class="ftueTitle" >' + title + '</span>' +
												 '<img class="ftueImage" src="/images/ci/ftue/AssistPromoModal.png"/>' +
												 '<span class="ftueText" >' + bodyText + '</span>' +
												 '</div>' +
												 '<div id="ftueFooter">' +
												 '<input class="submit ftueButton" type="submit" role="button" ' +
												 'value="' + buttonText + '" onclick=\'window.location="' + redirectUrl + '"\' />' +
												 '</div>';

					var lb = new lightbox.Lightbox(
						{
							lightboxId: 'ftueLightbox',
							contents: contents,
							closeOnBodyClick: false,
							onClose: 'showTooltip()'
						} );
					lb.open();
				}
			}

    function insertSkipLinkAfterBodyStart(referenceNode, newNode, linkContent)
    {
      if( top === self )
      {
        /* Evaluates if the page is not been loaded inside Iframe,
        only attach skip-link in original view, not Ultra, because ultra has his own skip link. */
        referenceNode.parentNode.insertBefore( newNode, referenceNode );
        newNode.innerHTML = linkContent;
      }
    }
